title: Define CodeWiki context-boundary and decision-row lifecycle policy
summary: Define and implement source-backed context boundaries for gateway passes, fresh validation, threshold compaction, validation checkpoint commits, Pi reload guidance, and richer decision-row state tracking without creating overlapping roadmap tasks.

goal.outcome: Gateway-passed builds and validated decision rows become compact source truth for next-loop context, fresh validators start from artifact refs, local checkpoint commits make validated content inspectable with Git, and Pi reload guidance appears when extension/runtime code may be stale.
acceptance: Decision, planning, and implementation gateway-pass handoffs define a CodeWiki-owned compaction or hard session-boundary recommendation seeded by codewiki_resume_context and the passed build plus validation refs.

Fresh validation context is required for implementation, task-close, publication/publish/release, and high-risk or semantic-system gates; decision/planning validation may request freshness based on policy or context health.

Automatic threshold compaction is supported only through safe boundaries: visible tool results are preserved, active task/build refs are externalized, and mid-loop compaction blocks or checkpoints instead of losing unstored intent.

Decision/planning compaction is allowed only after important user intent is externalized into pending/approved rows, KB/build/task/session evidence, or explicit blocking questions; ambiguity routes back to decision rather than guessing.

Validated implementation content can produce a local checkpoint commit after gateway pass, while task-close/publication metadata uses a separate close/publication commit; local commits are not remote publication.

Decision rows support or plan support for current project state, agreed change, expected final state, validated final state, status, and proof refs so future compaction/restart uses durable row truth.
Final summaries detect Pi extension/skill/runtime/API changes and include explicit reload-Pi guidance; compaction does not claim to reload live extension code and never auto-restarts Pi.

Tests cover post-gateway compaction timing, no pre-gateway compaction, fresh validation packet behavior, threshold safe-boundary behavior, reload notice/no-notice cases, checkpoint commit metadata, and decision-row lifecycle serialization or compatibility.
non_goals: Do not replace CodeWiki resume_context with chat-history/VCC recall.
Do not force compaction in the middle of an edit/check loop.
Do not restart Pi automatically or change Pi package install behavior.

Do not create separate overlapping tasks for commit policy, compaction override, validation freshness, reload guidance, or decision-row lifecycle unless TASK-049 implementation discovers an explicit split requirement.

delta.desired: One cohesive context-boundary policy covers gateway-pass compaction, fresh validation, threshold compaction, checkpoint commits, Pi reload guidance, and decision-row lifecycle proof without roadmap duplication.
delta.current: TASK-049 existed as a narrower post-gateway compaction/reload task; decision row state and validation checkpoint commit timing were not yet captured in roadmap acceptance.
delta.closure: Task closes when tests and validation prove boundary timing, source-backed compaction packets, fresh validator context, checkpoint commit guidance, reload notices, and decision-row lifecycle handling.
